phase_receipt_and_clean_contract: Before each command: exact HEAD/tree, empty tracked/untracked source status, unchanged Cargo.lock and MODULE.bazel.lock bytes, and pinned actual tool identity.
Retain exact argv/cwd, UTC start/end, elapsed duration, exit/timeout state, complete stdout/stderr raw bytes and SHA. Compile output is not a count of tests executed.
After each command: require identical HEAD/tree, clean full source status and unchanged lock bytes. Any timeout, nonzero exit or rewrite fails and stops subsequent commands.
On every terminal path keep full git diff --binary HEAD, cached diff and all changed files. Never erase or automatically apply linter proposals to the qualified source branch.

Three clean successful fix receipts close only this scoped instruction requirement. Rewritten bytes require root review and a separate source decision; old native evidence does not qualify them automatically.
No ref mutation, original provider turn replay or new model call belongs to this job.
limitations: This plan is not a hosted execution or qualification result. No workflow, test, fix, host process or model was launched by its author.
A Windows runner compiles the Windows-only token/helper code under its real cfg; a Linux package fix cannot establish that compilation coverage.
No runtime helper staging is required just to invoke clippy, since these commands do not run test children. Build scripts remain ordinary compiler prerequisites.
The plan covers the requested neuron/core/Windows delta, not all changed packages in the cumulative 109-path proposal.
